The worker's arms and hands are poorly defined and appear fused with the wooden plank they are touching. The anatomy is distorted, lacking clear finger definition or proper limb separation.
The wood grain exhibits repetitive patterns and 'smearing' effects, particularly on the top surfaces, lacking the natural random variation of real timber.
The structural beams in the upper background show slight warping and inconsistent perspective lines, suggesting a weak understanding of 3D geometry in the distance.
